summary.text: The match ended drawn after NSW were 440-6 declared in the first innings and 262-5 declared in the second, while WA posted 339-10 and 244-9. Kurtis Patterson top scored for NSW with 122 off 214 balls and Sam Konstas made 151 off 167 balls, whereas Kieran Elliott topped WA's first innings with 79 off 161 balls and Jayden Goodwin made 67 off 165 balls. Jhye Richardson took 2 for 78 against NSW, Jack Edwards 4 for 42 against WA, Corey Rocchiccioli 3 for 90 against NSW, and Ben Dwarshuis 4 for 50 against WA.
